fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Fires at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding their remaining damage to the shot, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Lurker's Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a round at an enemy up to 10 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lie Submerged
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Long Wait
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 40% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
